From: Elena Morales <elena@fincust.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Purge of prompts/outputs/logs for FinCust production tenant

Hi Jasmine,

We need Redwood to execute a full purge for our FinCust production tenant (tenant id: FC-4421). Scope: all prompt inputs, generation outputs, and ephemeral inference logs associated with FC-4421 going back 24 months. This is a compliance requirement for an upcoming audit.

Can you send the deletion-runbook you use for these requests, the expected timeline from formal approval, and a sample confirmation email we can retain? We also need the kind of proof Redwood will provide post-execution (hash lists, signed manifest, screenshots of S3 object listings removed, and any audit log exports). If you need a PO or signed attestation to proceed, say so.

Thanks — we’d like to get this scheduled within the next two weeks.

— Elena Morales
Head of Security Operations
FinCust
ops@fincust.com

P.S. Please include any notes about what is NOT impacted (backups, aggregated telemetry, etc.).

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Purge of prompts/outputs/logs for FinCust production tenant

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear request. We can handle this; background on process and next steps below.

Summary / immediate ask:
- We need a formal deletion request via your account contact (support@fincust.com or signed attestation).
- Please confirm the exact retention window (you said 24 months — do you want rolling 24 months or a cutoff date?).

High-level process (what Redwood will do):
1) Intake & scope confirmation (we'll validate tenant id and enumerate S3 prefixes, kvcache shards, trace indexes).
2) Pre-check snapshot (create a time-stamped integrity snapshot in our secure audit store — non-retrievable to customers).
3) Deletion execution (KV cache eviction, S3 object deletes with versioned object purging, trace DB row deletes).
4) Evidence capture (signed manifest with SHA256 of pre-deletion object list, deletion job logs, Drive evidence package).
5) Customer confirmation email + formal attestation doc.

Timeline: once we have a formal request and account owner approval, typical turnaround is 48–72 hours for non-blocked jobs. If your tenant is large (many S3 prefixes / > 100M objects) we'll provide a targeted schedule.

What we will NOT delete:
- Aggregated telemetry and anonymized monitoring metrics used for platform health.
- Customer-managed backups stored outside Redwood’s controlled buckets (we will document the locations).

I attached the runbook (erase-runbook-v1.pdf) and a draft confirmation-email template (confirmation-email-templates.docx). Ben and Priyom are looped in to own the technical execution and evidence capture.

Next: please send the formal request (email from support@fincust.com or signed doc) and confirm whether you want a single cutoff date (e.g., delete everything prior to 2026-06-01) or rolling 24 months.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinCust purge: prompts, outputs & logs — runbook and confirmation templates

Thanks for looping me in. A couple of technical clarifications and the checklist I’ll follow:

Checklist (execution):
- Verify tenant mapping (FC-4421) -> storage prefixes; list S3 prefixes and object counts.
- Create immutable pre-delete index: enumerate object keys and compute SHA256 manifest (store in write-once audit bucket).
- KV cache: evict all kvcache shards associated with tenant; confirm empty cache metrics.
- Model output traces: run trace DB purge where tenant_id = FC-4421; soft-delete markers converted to hard-delete after verification.
- Generation logs: delete S3 objects; if bucket versioning enabled, remove all versions and delete markers.
- Audit logs: export request traces for the deletion window and include them with the evidence package.
- Post-delete verification: run object enumeration to confirm zero objects at targeted prefixes; capture screenshots of bucket listing and job logs.

Risks / caveats:
- If FinCust has exported backups in an external S3 account, Redwood cannot delete those; we’ll identify and flag them.
- If any legal hold/retention hold exists (we'll check our retention control table), we’ll surface it back to you before execution.

Attachments I uploaded to the ticket: erase-runbook-v1.pdf (detailed play-by-play), and a sample signed-manifest template. I recommend we require a signed attestation from FinCust authorizing the purge (simple text + account id + signature).

I’ll prep the runbook steps and assign a run window once we have the signed request. Priyom — can you schedule a slot Wednesday evening (UTC) as a tentative window?

— Ben
Lead Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
